metadata.original_issue: Distribution parameter shape mismatch causes fatal signal in downstream methods.

knowledge_abstraction.general_principle: Constructors for tensor-valued probability distributions may accept parameters whose scalar, batch, and event dimensions are inconsistent, and downstream methods may assume these dimensions have already been validated, causing fatal numerical or shape-handling failures.

risk_dimensions.shape: Inconsistent scalar, batch, and event dimension combinations among distribution parameters
risk_dimensions.execution_state: Methods invoked after construction may assume parameter shapes were validated and consistent

failure_mechanism.description: The distribution API may not fully validate or normalize inconsistent parameter shapes at construction time; later shape-dependent operations can trigger arithmetic exceptions or unhandled execution paths.

input_exploration: Vary distribution parameter ranks across scalar, vector, and matrix combinations including zero-dimensional tensors
Probe mismatched batch dimensions among distribution parameters
Exercise distribution methods that consume the parameters, such as sampling and density evaluation
constraint_awareness: Distribution parameters must agree on event shape and broadcastable batch dimensions
Validation may reject some but not all invalid combinations, so bypass or vary validation paths
oracle_strategy: Monitor for fatal signals such as SIGFPE and SIGSEGV
Detect unexpected runtime exceptions or inconsistent shape-validation failures
Compare observed behavior against expected shape-contract validation outcomes

transferability.reason: The principle applies to any API that accepts multiple tensor parameters with implicit shape or broadcasting contracts, especially probability distributions, linear algebra operations, and loss functions.

llm_reasoning_guidance.important_considerations: Focus on parameter combinations that violate implicit shape contracts while remaining tensors, and invoke downstream methods to exercise assumed-validated paths.
generation_strategy: Generate harnesses that construct APIs with systematically varied parameter shapes and broadcasting combinations, then call methods that consume the inferred or stored shapes; use oracles to detect crashes, fatal signals, and improper validation behavior.
